Sandbox_LBF_TrackZombieKills_tooltip: Scores every zombie a player kills and shows a Zombie Kills board.
Sandbox_LBF_TrackPlayerKills_tooltip: Scores player-versus-player kills and shows a Player Kills board. Off by default.
Sandbox_LBF_AnnounceFirstPlace_tooltip: Tells the whole server in chat when a board's first place changes hands.
Sandbox_LBF_AnnounceCooldownMinutes_tool: Real minutes to wait between announcements on the same board, so two players trading the lead cannot flood chat. (0-120)
Sandbox_LBF_BoardSize_tooltip: How many ranks the server sends to each client. Players outside this still see their own standing. (3-50)
Sandbox_LBF_MinScoreToRank_tooltip: A player needs at least this much to appear on a board, so the list is not padded with everyone sitting on nothing. (1-1000)
